rationale: The revised plan addresses all three feedback items from the first execution. (1) The duplicate_check component now tests both adherence.member_id and the composite key adherence.member_id+therapeutic_class, ensuring complete candidate key validation per T1-candidate_keys feedback. (2) The write_report component adds the 'synthetic_data' caveat to clearly document that the dataset is synthetic, fulfilling T1-caveat_synthetic. (3) The 'sample_preview' caveat has been added to indicate that value samples shown are illustrative previews, addressing T1-caveat_sample_preview. All other components and parameters remain unchanged, preserving the comprehensive reconnaissance approach.
changes_summary: Added adherence.member_id and adherence.member_id+therapeutic_class to duplicate_check keys parameter; added synthetic_data and sample_preview caveats to write_report caveats parameter.
